unverified.detail: Moves Spot balance to the Futures wallet. This client's [secrets] only provisions Spot credentials (client.toml/core.md scope this pass to Spot only) -- there is no Futures API access to move the tiny real balance back if this succeeds. Not attempted.

spec.description: Transfer from a Kraken Spot wallet to a Kraken Futures wallet. A transfer in the other direction must be requested via the Kraken Futures API withdrawal-to-Spot-wallet endpoint instead. Requires the `Funds permissions - Query` API key permission.

response.title: WalletTransferReceiptFrame
response.description: Wire frame; the generated method returns `result`.

error.description: Wire envelope field; see the core.

result.title: WalletTransferReceipt
result.description: Reference to the created wallet transfer.

notes: Upstream `requestBody` requires `nonce`; dropped from this schema since the core's `authed_request` (`core/transport/http.py`) injects a strictly-increasing nonce into every private call automatically -- it is never a caller-supplied parameter, matching the existing hand-written `deposit_methods(self, asset)` signature, which takes none.

Only one direction (Spot -> Futures) is reachable via Spot REST, hence `from`/`to` each being a documented single-value `enum` rather than a real choice; kept as `enum` per spec-authoring rule 2 rather than a bare string, since the closed set (of one) is exactly what upstream documents.
